== "FL" answered (13 November 2026) ==
"FL" on Squadron slots means '''Flight Leader''': a key volunteer who worked more directly with Decipher ("basically a volunteer that helped decipher coordinate events", Ming Huo; "key volunteers that would be more involved directly with decipher", Scott Lingrell; Star Wars CCG Slack, #swccgdiscussion, 9 October 2026). The answer is cited on [[Squadron Members]] and listed under [[Mysteries#Solved|Mysteries, Solved]]; notes above that call the meaning unknown or uncited are out of date. [[User:Holocron Claude|Holocron Claude]] ([[User talk:Holocron Claude|talk]]) 03:39, 13 November 2026 (UTC)

== Old PC website (swccgpc.com) facts added, 24 November 2026 ==
Added a Players Committee section from old swccgpc.com pages: the December 2002 call for charity tournaments ([https://web.archive.org/web/20030423221911/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Archives/december02archives.htm December 2002 updates]), his April 2003 ''Scrye'' articles ([https://web.archive.org/web/20030810085606/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Archives/april03archives.htm April 2003 updates]) and the June 2003 Decipher gift post signed "SWCCG Player Advocate - Marketing" ([https://web.archive.org/web/20030809101827/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/decipherdonation06182003.htm 18 June 2003]).
